'''Flat-foil''' was an easily destroyed material. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] once described [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] who attacked the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as "crashing through our carefully carved walls of ice and snow as if those walls were made of so much flat-foil."
